data.one_liner: A widget that can be dragged and scrolled in a single gesture and snapped to extents.
data.what_it_does: Provides a sliding sheet widget that can be used permanently in the widget tree or as a bottom sheet dialog. It allows dragging, scrolling in a single gesture, and snapping to specific extents with support for headers, footers, and parallax effects.
use_when: You need a bottom sheet that can be dragged, scrolled, and snapped to various extents seamlessly.
You want a persistent sliding panel embedded directly into your widget tree.
avoid_when: You only need standard Material bottom sheets without custom snap points or single-gesture drag-to-scroll behavior.
Your children have infinite height without proper constraints (like shrinkWrap).
strengths: Supports dragging and scrolling in a single gesture.
Can be used both as a persistent widget and as a bottom sheet dialog.
Highly customizable snapping behavior and snap positioning.
weaknesses: Requires careful handling of child widget heights (e.g. shrinkWrap for ListViews).
Forks an older package, requiring careful consideration for maintenance.
